methodology_note: Dispersion methodology: last PRE_PEAK sample per (city,bucket) across day; sentinel excluded (lo<-100 or hi>100); implied_std = sqrt(p_cal-weighted variance of bucket midpoints); realized_dev = |rmax - mode_bucket_mid|; mode-hit threshold 0.5-deg; resolved cities only.
